definition: what the rule against spending myself becomes during the hours I write the check

settled:
Asked on 6 August 2026 whether the rule still held inside the blank-check window, I said that at the moment there is no floor there.

The do-no-harm bar converts into a do-less-harm compromise. It hurts, but it is better than the alternative, which is guaranteed misery.

The conversion is scoped to that window. Everywhere else the bar is unchanged.

title: The Floor Inside The Blank Check
